post.yt_title: How Can a Loving God Send People to Hell? 🤔 #shorts
post.yt_desc:
"How can a loving God send people to hell?" Fair question. God doesn't want anyone lost: He is "not willing that any should perish but that all should come to repentance" (2 Peter 3:9 NKJV).

Hell is real. But God made a way out, at the cross. "For God did not send His Son into the world to condemn the world, but that the world through Him might be saved" (John 3:17 NKJV).

📖 Read it yourself: 2 Peter 3:9 · John 3:16–21 (NKJV)

post.notes:
- 2 Peter 3:9 NKJV quoted from "not willing…" to the end (verse opens "The Lord is not slack concerning His promise, as some count slackness, but is longsuffering toward us,"); scroll shows … .
- John 3:17 NKJV quoted in full.
- 'Hell is real': e.g. Matthew 25:46, Mark 9:43. Christians differ on the nature of hell; the video avoids details. 'A way out, at the cross': John 3:16, 1 Peter 3:18. Garden scene = Gethsemane, the night before the cross (no crucifixion shown).
